verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no general event-driven rules or automation feature, such as triggers on job completion or user-defined event-to-action rules. What it does show is adjacent only. Endpoint autoscaling between replica bounds is a narrow scaling control, not user-defined event rules. Function calling and agent loops are developer building blocks the user would execute in their own application.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
